summary: Iteration 100 - Revenue Management Left Sidebar Redesign Testing Complete. All 20 navigation items working with new grouped sidebar layout. UI redesign from horizontal tabs to vertical left sidebar with 6 categories (Overview, Pricing, Intelligence, Automation, Distribution, Finance) verified. All features functional.

tests: Revenue sidebar renders on left side with data-testid='rev-sidebar'
Dark background (bg-stone-900) applied correctly
6 grouped sections visible: Overview, Pricing, Intelligence, Automation, Distribution, Finance
Section labels in uppercase with proper styling
All 20 navigation items visible and clickable
Dashboard loads by default when entering Revenue Mgmt
Dashboard tab shows active state with violet styling
Active item shows violet accent bar on left (bg-violet-500)
Active item has violet background tint (bg-violet-600/20)
Active item icon has violet color (text-violet-400)
Breadcrumb shows 'Revenue > [Tab Name]' for non-dashboard tabs
Breadcrumb hidden on Dashboard tab
Revenue link in breadcrumb navigates back to Dashboard
Collapse toggle button has data-testid='rev-sidebar-toggle'
Clicking toggle collapses sidebar to w-14 width
Collapsed sidebar shows only icons
Clicking toggle again expands sidebar to w-56 width
Collapsed sidebar shows tooltips on hover
Tooltips display item label text
Rate Calendar loads with monthly view
Calendar shows prices (£70, £150, £175, £225)
View toggles visible (Prices, Occupancy, Pickup, Bulk Edit)
Room Type dropdown available
Click to edit instruction visible
AI Copilot loads with 'Powered by GPT-52 • Online' status
Input field accepts messages
AI responds with occupancy analysis
Quick test and Clear Chat buttons visible
Forecasting loads with 30-Day Occupancy Forecast chart
Forecast vs SDLY Comparison table visible
KPI cards: Avg Forecast Occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, Total Rooms on Books
Export and Recalculate buttons visible
Accuracy percentage displayed
Reports & Export tab shows 7 export cards
Cards: Executive Summary, Performance, Pickup Report, Budget Variance, Forecasting, Profit OS, Distribution
Each card has Export button
Tip banner about Excel vs CSV exports visible
Analytics has 3 sub-tabs: Performance, Pickup Report, Budget Variance
Performance sub-tab shows Occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, Room Revenue
Day of Week Performance chart visible
Segment Mix chart visible
Trend Analysis section visible
Profit OS loads with Avg Gross ADR, Avg Net ADR, Avg ContributionPAR
Channel Breakdown table visible
Export button in header

critical_code_review_comments: RevenuePanel.js well-structured with NAV_SECTIONS array for 6 categories
All 20 nav items have proper data-testid attributes (rev-tab-{id})
Sidebar collapse/expand animation smooth with transition-all duration-300
Tooltip implementation uses group-hover:opacity-100 pattern correctly
Violet accent bar positioned with absolute left-0 for active state
Breadcrumb conditionally rendered only for non-dashboard tabs
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 100 redesigned Revenue Management from horizontal tab bar (20 tabs) to left sidebar navigation with 6 grouped categories. Sidebar has data-testid='rev-sidebar', toggle has data-testid='rev-sidebar-toggle', each nav item has data-testid='rev-tab-{id}'. Collapse toggle works, tooltips show on hover when collapsed. All 20 modules preserved and functional. Active state shows violet accent bar on left side.

mocked_apis.note: All APIs are real. No changes to backend in this iteration.
